How this is made

The engine polls each source on its own clock and keeps two times per item: when the source published it and when we saw it. Classification is by rules (listing, delisting, macro, hack, ETF, regulation, whale, filing, politics, adoption, protocol, unlock); promotions and trading-pair housekeeping score zero. Confirmation counts distinct desks reporting one story within six hours. Nothing here is a buy or sell call. The same events drive the What moved it indicator on every chart and the Ask AI brief. Free JSON: /api/catalysts, /api/catalysts/top, /api/catalysts/moves.
